_meta.note: S1 FIX (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep): the 3 COMMENT-ONLY-MATCH entries (cta-section headline/body, hero subHeadline) that used to sit at the top of `entries` are REMOVED — core/sources.js's PHP comment stripper was fixed to also blank full-line `//` comments (it previously stripped only `/* */`), so these 3 attributes no longer false-match the render corpus at all and generate zero findings. They are genuinely dead attrs (CHECK 4's declared-and-unrendered shape), not this rule's concern. TRIAGE PASS 2026-08-08. The rule's live population was 280 across 35 of 83 blocks. It is NOT a backlog figure until every entry is either a verified defect or a baselined false positive with a checkable reason — that is what this pass produced, and a SMALLER NUMBER WAS NOT THE GOAL. Four false-positive CLASSES were found by building a per-finding evidence table (which render file matched, and by what mechanism: literal name / dynamic suffix / dynamic prefix / comment-only). ONE class was fixed in the rule rather than baselined, because it recurs on every block and is a WordPress contract, not a per-case exception: six findings whose control is rendered by WORDPRESS CORE from the block's own `supports` (anchor / align / color.background / color.text / typography.textAlign) — core's controls live in neither edit.js nor any SGS shared component, so the rule's two corpora could never see them. That is a SECOND structurally-invisible control surface, sibling to the extension surface the contract names at §'The EXTENSION SURFACE axis', and not covered by it. Fixed in rules/21-render-without-control.js (`coreSupportedAttrs`) with a fixture PAIR — `core-supports-provided-control` (mustNotFlag) and its positive twin `core-supports-absent-still-flags` (mustFlag, same defect shape with `supports` removed) — so the exclusion is provably able to fail rather than being an unconditional name skip. Measured: 280 -> 274, exactly the six identified. The remaining THREE classes are baselined below (12 entries) because each fix would touch machinery shared by other rules, whose committed backlogs would silently restage — the same 'a write with an untraced reader propagates silently' hazard the rule header cites for not widening core/components.js. SURVIVING REAL POPULATION: 243 FLAGGED across 32 of 83 blocks (⛔ CORRECTED from 262 by a 4-rater QC council the same day — it found a fifth false-positive class of 20, and falsified the textAlign entry of the core-supports map, which is now flagged again as a real defect. Arithmetic: 262 - 20 + 1 = 243. The class was fixed in the rule, not baselined, so no entry below changed. Full account in the rule's advisoryReason and D532.) The dominant real family is not in the original 53: blocks that pass $attributes wholesale to SGS_Container_Wrapper::render() inherit the wrapper's entire attribute vocabulary as 'rendered', so every container/grid/background attr they declare without a control is genuinely frozen at its block.json default forever (physics-canvas 79, nav-menu 17, site-header-row 12, site-footer-row 12). VERIFIED, not assumed: nav-menu/render.php:1436 passes $attributes wholesale and nav-menu/edit.js mentions none of the 17. ⚠ The expected false positive named in the handoff, `team-member.overlayHover`, DID NOT MATERIALISE — team-member's four findings are all hover values (scaleHover/shadowHover/imageZoomHover/grayscaleHover) and overlayHover is not among them.
